entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Passing on the societal ills we have[n]created to the next generation...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: ...Is not right!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: It will take time to solve this problem.[n]However, we must start by making[n]small changes!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I hope you gleaned something[n]useful from today's speech.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Regardless of the audience's size,[n]you must convey your thoughts as if[n]you're talking one-on-one.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: By the way, I forgot to ask you[n]last time we spoke. Why do you[n]want to become a politician?
I want to change the world.
I want to improve my speech.[clr 27]
I'm not sure...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Ambitious, indeed, if a little ambiguous...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Well, I'm sure you'll iron out[n]the details as you go along.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Haha... So you're a pragmatist.[n]Most people nowadays are.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: But that mentality of taking action is[n]the quality of a good politician.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Perhaps you're simply too[n]embarrassed to tell me.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: May I ask you one more question?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: What kind of politician do you want to be?
One with conviction.[clr 27]
A popular one.
I don't know yet.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Yes, don't ever forget that. Although,[n]what's important is what lies within.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Support and popularity are[n]important, yes, but you mustn't[n]make those your main objectives...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I appreciate your honesty.[n]Well, you still have plenty[n]of time to figure it out.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: ...Allow me to give you some advice.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: If you aspire to get into politics, you[n]must possess a central philosophy.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: What is it that you want to accomplish...?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: That is the foundation of a great speech.[n]You'd do well to remember that.
That was helpful.[clr 27]
I knew that already.
What I want to accomplish?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I'm glad. By the way, my philosophy is...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Haha... Well, it is the most basic of basics.[n]By the way, my philosophy is...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I suppose you haven't figured[n]that out yet, hm? By the way,[n]my philosophy is...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Never give up until your voice is heard...!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: To get your message across,[n]be tenacious in conveying[n]your thoughts to the audience.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Have a firm point of view, and[n]communicate it clearly—that's[n]the first rule of negotiating.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Haha! You have me reliving[n]the fighting spirit I had when I first[n]became a politician.
Yoshida explained the basics [n]of speech-giving. I feel like my [n]bond with him is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Yoshida Detractor
entries.en: Get the hell outta here, No-Good Tora!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: No-Good Tora...!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: They're right... I am no good...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Ah, my apologies. We're done for today.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Thank you for all your hard work.[n]I'll see you next time.
